verdict.rationale: The evidence shows users can manually pick any model through OpenRouter or bring their own keys, and can route model traffic through an approved gateway for policy control. Neither is automatic per-task routing to the most suitable model, so both are adjacent features only. No documentation describes LightSprint selecting a model based on the task prompt.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model
